report.summary: Three findings narrowed; one (missing-included-list) needs inspection of daedalus/structcore/slice.py to confirm if 'included' list is updated; token-integrity-verification-gap needs full LowIntegrityLog.__init__ in containment.py; exception-overreach needs handler body in bootstrap.py.
risks: missing-included-list could cause incorrect slice behavior when include_focus=False, potentially leaking focus or omitting dependencies.
token-integrity-verification-gap: if LowIntegrityLog.__init__ does not verify, file-level integrity attestation may be incomplete.
exception-overreach: catching BaseException without re-raise may suppress SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt, causing shutdown delays or resource leaks.
todos: Inspect daedalus/structcore/slice.py for 'included' list update logic.
Inspect daedalus/spine/containment.py for LowIntegrityLog.__init__ integrity verification.
Inspect daedalus/spine/bootstrap.py for exception handler body around BaseException.

items.title: Inspect slice.py to verify 'included' list update when include_focus=False
items.why_now: The missing-included-list finding (severity high) could cause incorrect slice behavior, affecting all downstream context planning and prompt assembly. Must be resolved before gate 1 vertical slice.

steps.do: Open daedalus/structcore/slice.py and search for 'included' list. Verify that it is updated when include_focus=False, and that omitted items are correctly reported as mode='omitted'.
steps.verified_by: Run existing tests for slice module (test_slice_include_focus.py) and check that they cover include_focus=False case. Add test if missing.

items.assumption: The slice function is in daedalus/structcore/slice.py as per cited_source. The test file test_slice_include_focus.py is expected to exist.

items.title: Verify LowIntegrityLog.__init__ reads back integrity label
items.why_now: The token-integrity-verification-gap finding (medium severity) questions whether LowIntegrityLog.__init__ verifies the integrity label. If not, file-level attestation may be incomplete, affecting containment guarantees.

steps.do: Open daedalus/spine/containment.py, locate LowIntegrityLog.__init__, and check if it reads back the integrity SID from the file handle and compares it to LOW_INTEGRITY_SID.
steps.verified_by: Inspect code; run test_gate_containment.py to ensure containment tests still pass.

items.assumption: LowIntegrityLog is defined in daedalus/spine/containment.py as per index.

items.title: Examine exception handler in bootstrap.py refresh_sources for BaseException handling
items.why_now: The exception-overreach finding (medium severity) warns that catching BaseException may suppress SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt. Must confirm handler re-raises or handles them appropriately to avoid shutdown issues.

steps.do: Open daedalus/spine/bootstrap.py, locate the except clause around lines 172-173 (refresh_sources function), and examine the handler body. Ensure SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt are re-raised or handled explicitly.
steps.verified_by: Run test_bootstrap_receipt.py to verify bootstrap behavior; add a test that sends KeyboardInterrupt during refresh_sources and confirms it propagates.

items.assumption: The except clause is in daedalus/spine/bootstrap.py as per cited_source.

items.title: Verify _spectrum never returns empty list for graphs with n>=3 and edges>0
items.why_now: The empty-graph-fallback finding (low severity) is theoretically reachable only if _spectrum returns empty list. Confirming it never happens closes the finding and eliminates a potential silent failure.

steps.do: Inspect _spectrum function in daedalus/mapping/spectral.py. Ensure that for any graph with n>=3 and edges>0, it returns a non-empty list of eigenvalues. Add a unit test with a 3-node, 1-edge graph.
steps.verified_by: Run test_mapping_spectral.py; add test case for minimal connected graph.

items.assumption: _spectrum is in daedalus/mapping/spectral.py as per index.
